cohort: 27 women aged 19-72 years with Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (DEB) were recruited from two centres.
finding: Women with Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (DEB) can experience pregnancies and deliveries, often without major complications, highlighting the necessity for specialized gynaecological and sexology follow-up.
mod_finding: Out of 21 recorded deliveries, 8 were caesarean sections and 13 were vaginal deliveries, indicating that both modes of birth are feasible for women with DEB.
